newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares end down, hit by currency qualms.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares end down, hit by currency qualms.

text.p: Singapore shares ended weaker on Monday as caution about regional currency stability overtook an otherwise optimistic view of the country's electronics companies, dealers said.
"Electronics look good for the second half, but the currency question is keeping people out," said one dealer.
"Investors desperately want things to be better, but the signs are still not all there," said another dealer.
Singapore's blue chip Straits Times Industrials Index reflected the cautious approach of the international fund managers, slipping 5.95 points to 1,975.01 at the close.
